```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
import re
import yaml
from IPython.display import display, HTML

talks = yaml.safe_load(open("./talks/talks.yaml")) or []


def slugify(text):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-") or "event"


# Talks that share the same "event" (e.g. two presentations at the same
# conference) are grouped under a single button/pin; clicking it shows all
# of them in the panel. Order is preserved by first appearance.
groups_by_event = {}
event_order = []
for talk in talks:
    event = talk["event"]
    if event not in groups_by_event:
        groups_by_event[event] = []
        event_order.append(event)
    groups_by_event[event].append(talk)

groups = []
for event in event_order:
    items = groups_by_event[event]
    alias = items[0]["alias"] if len(items) == 1 else "grp-" + slugify(event)
    groups.append(
        {
            "alias": alias,
            "event": event,
            "language": items[0].get("language"),
            "talks": items,
        }
    )

LANGUAGE_FLAGS = {
    "fr": "🇫🇷",
    "en": "🇬🇧",
    "es": "🇪🇸",
    "de": "🇩🇪",
    "it": "🇮🇹",
    "pt": "🇵🇹",
    "nl": "🇳🇱",
}


TWEMOJI_BASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@14.0.2/assets/svg"


def flag_span(language):
    flag = LANGUAGE_FLAGS.get((language or "").lower())
    if not flag:
        return ""
    codepoints = "-".join(f"{ord(ch):x}" for ch in flag if ch != "️")
    src = f"{TWEMOJI_BASE}/{codepoints}.svg"
    return f'<img class="talk-flag" src="{src}" alt="{language}" title="{language}" loading="lazy"> '


buttons_html = "".join(
    f'<button type="button" class="talk-btn" data-alias="{g["alias"]}">'
    f'{flag_span(g.get("language"))}{g["event"]}</button>'
    for g in groups
)
talks_json = json.dumps(groups).replace("</", "<\\/")

markup = f"""
<div class="talks-view-toggle" id="talks-view-toggle">
    <button type="button" class="is-active" data-view="list">List</button>
    <button type="button" data-view="map">Map</button>
</div>

<div class="talks-columns" id="talks-columns" data-mobile-view="list">
    <div class="talks-buttons-col">
        <div class="talks-buttons-wrap" id="talks-buttons-wrap">
            <div class="talks-buttons" id="talks-buttons">
            {buttons_html}
            </div>
            <div class="talks-buttons-fade">
                <button type="button" class="talks-show-more" id="talks-show-more">Show more ▾</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="talks-map-col" id="talks-map-col">
"""
# The {{ojs}} map chunk that follows renders its output right here, inside
# this still-open .talks-map-col — the closing tags come from the next
# Python chunk after it. Raw HTML blocks are passed through verbatim, so an
# element opened in one chunk can be closed in a later one.

display(HTML(markup))


def parse_coords(text):
    """Accepts whatever Google Maps happens to give you: the desktop
    "Latitude : X° N / Longitude : Y° E" panel, a single-line "X N, Y E"
    paste, or the plain mobile "X, Y" long-press copy. The hemisphere
    letter (not its label) decides whether a number is a lat or a lng,
    so mislabelled or reordered pastes still resolve correctly."""
    if not text:
        return None
    matches = re.findall(r"(-?[\d.]+)\s*°?\s*([NSEW])", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if matches:
        lat = lng = None
        for value, hemi in matches:
            magnitude = abs(float(value))
            hemi = hemi.upper()
            if hemi in ("N", "S"):
                lat = -magnitude if hemi == "S" else magnitude
            else:
                lng = -magnitude if hemi == "W" else magnitude
        if lat is not None and lng is not None:
            return lat, lng
    plain = re.match(r"^\s*(-?[\d.]+)\s*,\s*(-?[\d.]+)\s*$", text.strip())
    if plain:
        return float(plain.group(1)), float(plain.group(2))
    return None


map_points = []
for g in groups:
    parsed = None
    for talk in g["talks"]:
        parsed = parse_coords(talk.get("coords"))
        if parsed is not None:
            break
    if parsed is None:
        continue
    lat, lng = parsed
    map_points.append(
        {
            "alias": g["alias"],
            "event": g["event"],
            "lat": lat,
            "lng": lng,
        }
    )

ojs_define(talks_map_data=map_points)
```

```{ojs}
maplibregl = (await import("https://esm.sh/maplibre-gl@4.7.1")).default

map = {
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "talks-map";
  yield container;

  const m = new maplibregl.Map({
    container,
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty",
    center: [4, 46],
    zoom: 3
  });
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right");

  m.on("load", () => {
    if (!talks_map_data.length) return;
    const bounds = new maplibregl.LngLatBounds();
    talks_map_data.forEach((t) => {
      const marker = new maplibregl.Marker({ color: "#eb6864" })
        .setLngLat([t.lng, t.lat])
        .addTo(m);

      const el = marker.getElement();
      el.style.cursor = "pointer";
      el.title = t.event;
      let leaveTimeout = null;
      el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => {
        clearTimeout(leaveTimeout);
        window.__talksHoverPreview && window.__talksHoverPreview(t.alias);
      });
      el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
        // MapLibre repositions marker elements on every map render, so the
        // pin can shift a pixel or two under the cursor while it's loading
        // tiles, firing spurious enter/leave pairs. Debounce the "leave" so
        // a near-immediate re-enter cancels it instead of flip-flopping the
        // panel content.
        leaveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
          window.__talksHoverEnd && window.__talksHoverEnd();
        }, 150);
      });
      el.addEventListener("click", () => {
        window.__talksSelect && window.__talksSelect(t.alias);
      });

      bounds.extend([t.lng, t.lat]);
    });
    m.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: 60, maxZoom: 8 });
  });
}
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
closing_markup = """
    </div>
</div>

<div class="talk-panel" id="talk-panel" tabindex="-1">
    <p class="talk-panel-placeholder">Hover or click a talk above to see it here.</p>
</div>

<script id="talks-data" type="application/json">
"""
closing_markup += talks_json + "</script>"

script = """
<script>
(function () {
    const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById("talks-data").textContent);
    const talksByAlias = {};
    data.forEach((group) => {
        talksByAlias[group.alias] = group;
        // Deep links to an individual talk's own alias (e.g. from an old
        // URL) still resolve, landing on the group it now belongs to.
        group.talks.forEach((t) => { talksByAlias[t.alias] = group; });
    });
    const panel = document.getElementById("talk-panel");
    const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".talk-btn"));
    let selectedAlias = null;
    let renderedAlias = null;

    function embedSlides(url) {
        // Serve PDFs through PDF.js's own viewer instead of framing the file
        // directly: some hosts (e.g. GitHub's raw file server) send
        // "X-Frame-Options: deny" and an octet-stream content-type on PDFs,
        // which makes a plain <iframe src="..."> download the file instead
        // of showing it. PDF.js fetches the bytes itself (allowed by CORS)
        // rather than navigating the iframe to that URL, so it renders fine.
        const isPdf = /\\.pdf\\/?(?:[?#]|$)/i.test(url);
        const src = isPdf
            ? `https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/web/viewer.html?file=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`
            : url;
        return `<div class="talk-embed"><iframe src="${src}" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe></div>`;
    }

    function embedVideo(url) {
        const youtube = url.match(/(?:youtu\\.be\\/|youtube\\.com\\/(?:watch\\?v=|embed\\/))([\\w-]+)/);
        const vimeo = url.match(/vimeo\\.com\\/(\\d+)/);
        if (youtube) {
            return `<div class="talk-embed"><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/${youtube[1]}" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe></div>`;
        }
        if (vimeo) {
            return `<div class="talk-embed"><iframe src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/${vimeo[1]}" loading="lazy" allowfullscreen></iframe></div>`;
        }
        return `<div class="talk-embed"><video controls src="${url}"></video></div>`;
    }

    function talkEmbedsHtml(talk) {
        let html = "";
        if (talk.slides) html += embedSlides(talk.slides);
        if (talk.video) html += embedVideo(talk.video);
        if (!talk.slides && !talk.video) {
            html += '<p class="talk-panel-placeholder">No slides or video available yet.</p>';
        }
        return html;
    }

    function renderTalk(alias) {
        if (alias === renderedAlias) return;
        const group = talksByAlias[alias];
        if (!group) return;
        renderedAlias = alias;
        const items = group.talks;
        let html;
        if (items.length === 1) {
            const talk = items[0];
            html = `<h3 class="talk-panel-title no-anchor">${talk.title || talk.event}</h3>`;
            const metaParts = talk.title ? [talk.event, talk.date, talk.location, talk.language] : [talk.date, talk.location, talk.language];
            const meta = metaParts.filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
            if (meta) html += `<p class="talk-panel-meta">${meta}</p>`;
            html += talkEmbedsHtml(talk);
        } else {
            html = `<h3 class="talk-panel-title no-anchor">${group.event}</h3>`;
            items.forEach((talk, i) => {
                html += `<div class="talk-subitem">`;
                html += `<h4 class="talk-subitem-title no-anchor">${talk.title || `Talk ${i + 1}`}</h4>`;
                const meta = [talk.date, talk.location, talk.language].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
                if (meta) html += `<p class="talk-panel-meta">${meta}</p>`;
                html += talkEmbedsHtml(talk);
                html += `</div>`;
            });
        }
        panel.innerHTML = html;
    }

    function showPlaceholder() {
        renderedAlias = null;
        panel.innerHTML = '<p class="talk-panel-placeholder">Hover or click a talk above to see it here.</p>';
    }

    function restoreSelection() {
        if (selectedAlias) {
            renderTalk(selectedAlias);
        } else {
            showPlaceholder();
        }
    }

    function selectTalk(alias, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        selectedAlias = alias;
        buttons.forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-selected", b.dataset.alias === alias));
        renderTalk(alias);
        history.replaceState(null, "", "#" + alias);
        if (opts.scroll !== false) {
            panel.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
        }
    }

    buttons.forEach((btn) => {
        const alias = btn.dataset.alias;
        btn.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => renderTalk(alias));
        btn.addEventListener("mouseleave", restoreSelection);
        btn.addEventListener("focus", () => renderTalk(alias));
        btn.addEventListener("blur", restoreSelection);
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => selectTalk(alias));
    });

    const initialAlias = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.replace(/^#/, ""));
    if (initialAlias && talksByAlias[initialAlias]) {
        selectTalk(initialAlias, { scroll: true });
    }

    const buttonsWrap = document.getElementById("talks-buttons-wrap");
    const showMoreBtn = document.getElementById("talks-show-more");
    if (buttonsWrap && showMoreBtn) {
        if (buttons.length && buttonsWrap.scrollHeight <= buttonsWrap.clientHeight + 2) {
            // Everything already fits within the collapsed height: no need
            // for the fade/toggle at all.
            buttonsWrap.querySelector(".talks-buttons-fade").style.display = "none";
        } else {
            showMoreBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
                const expanded = buttonsWrap.classList.toggle("is-expanded");
                showMoreBtn.textContent = expanded ? "Show less ▴" : "Show more ▾";
            });
        }
    }

    const viewToggle = document.getElementById("talks-view-toggle");
    if (viewToggle) {
        const viewButtons = Array.from(viewToggle.querySelectorAll("button"));
        viewButtons.forEach((btn) => {
            btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
                document.getElementById("talks-columns").dataset.mobileView = btn.dataset.view;
                viewButtons.forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle("is-active", b === btn));
            });
        });
    }

    window.__talksHoverPreview = renderTalk;
    window.__talksHoverEnd = restoreSelection;
    window.__talksSelect = selectTalk;
})();
</script>
"""

display(HTML(closing_markup + script))
```
